title: Splitty
tagline: Payment splitter written in Solidity for the Ethereum network
description: Splitty is an iOS app that manages expense splitting and expense settlement with the power of Ethereum. A user can interface with the clean and simple UI to register and create expense groups, add new members, and, obviously, add expenses. When a member is added to an expense group, a smart contract to log their current wallet and how much they owe is created and trigger a payment to a destination address. This provides a unique way of managing your real-world payments, while settling them using DeFi.
